objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g., Level 2, Level 4).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g., RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via its properties.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Defined retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension check, typically 3 years.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled supplementary document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, following the main document release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently without affecting the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, triggering a review process for extending document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering the override (out-of-force) workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles such as author, reviewer, or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g., Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution membership.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A structured multi-step approval or processing sequence supporting document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow process (e.g., release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow (e.g., active, completed, cancelled).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator, Review, Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_author
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator step).

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, cancelling remaining tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled document) is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: process_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator upon completion.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or full release team) confirms the document remains valid, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are notified by email about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement of the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released via a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are permanently deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment is a controlled supplementary document linked to and released with a main document.
Additional information is a non-controlled supplementary object linked to a document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references a specific invalidated document to be restored.
One or more templates can be defined per document type and selected when creating a new document.
A distribution list is maintained per document defining recipients for notification and acknowledgement.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute.
In a multi-client system, a document can be made visible or hidden in specific clients.
Users are assigned to user groups which determine their system roles and authorizations.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups whose members receive the document.
A distribution list can contain individual persons directly assigned for distribution.
